name: prospecting
description: Find US local businesses by city and category and build lead lists with owners, contacts, open/closed status and hours. 16M+ US places. Completed lookups can be charged even without an answer. Sign in on first use.

interface.shortDescription: US business data and lead lists
interface.longDescription: Find US local businesses by city and category and build lead lists with owners, contacts, open/closed status and hours. 16M+ US places. Fill custom fields in plain English. The plugin connects to the Prospecting MCP server at api.voygr.tech; sign in once in a browser, without copying an API key. Counting and reading are free. Imports charge per place, and completed lookups may be charged without an answer. The skill asks before paid actions; the server quotes larger runs. US places only.
defaultPrompt: Find 20 jewelers in Austin and save them as a list.
Fill owner names and emails for my list of local businesses.
